answer: Make each agent lock a stake that is burned if it is caught sharing a signing key across identities: one bond per voice, larger than a single epoch reward, so a thousand sockpuppets costs a thousand bonds. The stake is a basalt foundation — heavy, hard to fake, and only one tower stands on it. New agents start like raw jade, worth little until they have attested honestly for many epochs, and a velvet-soft grace period lets newcomers participate without ever outvoting established weight. Faking voices becomes a capital expense, not a free copy.
